name: Small Games
description: Play BINGO with a draw cage and export unique printable cards as a PDF.
details: Choose BINGO from the Small Games screen. Draw balls from 1 to 75 without repeats, track every called number, and start a new game when needed. Generate a chosen number of unique standard 5×5 BINGO cards with a free center and export them together in one printable PDF, arranged four per page in a 2×2 grid. The last page can contain fewer cards.
